rules.topic: EnderIO 6 energy conduits have NO fixed tiers or transfer rate: each conduit node is a small energy buffer whose capacity self-adjusts - it starts at 500 FE (EnergyConduitData.java line 22), doubles whenever it saturates (up to 1000000000), and halves toward the amount actually stored when it runs dry (lines 69-72). Throughput is whatever connected machines push and pull; do not quote classic EnderIO conduit tier rates for this version

Fluid conduit tiers by transfer rate: fluid conduit 50 mB/t, pressurized fluid conduit 100 mB/t (line 45), ender fluid conduit 200 mB/t and it is the only multi-fluid tier (several fluids can share one conduit)
Item conduits extract 4 items per operation by default; an extraction speed upgrade multiplies that by 2 per upgrade tier (line 41: speed *= 2^tier)

Machine capacitor items scale EnderIO machines by their base value: basic capacitor 1.0, double-layer capacitor 2.0 (line 15), octadic capacitor 3.0 (line 16); the base scales machine energy capacity, intake and processing speed through the capacitor scalables, so an octadic machine runs its recipes at up to 3x the base energy stats

Capacitor banks come in basic, advanced and vibrant tiers with per-block capacities set as server config defaults: basic 500000 FE, advanced 2000000 FE, vibrant 4000000 FE (EnergyConfig.java lines 116-118); banks form multiblock storage where total capacity is the sum over the bank's blocks
